Subject (in full) Speech on Anti-Japanese Movement broadcast in the Settlement.

Made by and Forwarded by C. D. I. Robertson

Inquiries made regarding the authenticity of the contents
of an article which appeared in the Sin Wan Pao and other local
Chinese newspapers of August 17, 1931 (translation attached)
referring to a speech on the Anti-Japanese Movement broadcast
from the "Radio Station of the Dah Chung Hwa Electricity Supply
Company, Nanking Road", which is better known as the Great China
Broadcasting Station of the National Electric Supply Co. between
10 a.m. and 11 a.m. August 16 by Pan Kung Chai, Chief of the
Social Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and member
of the newly elected Executive Committee of the local Kuomintang
Headquarters, are substantially correct. According to Chen
Niang-jien (陳仰乾), manager of the National Electric Supply
Co. 501/3 Nanking Road who own and operate the Great China
Broadcasting Station at the same address, in July 1931 an
application was received from the local 3rd District Kuomintang
Headquarters with offices in the Temple of the Queen of Heaven,
North Honan Road requesting permission to broadcast between 10
and 11 a.m. every Sunday commencing from August 2, lectures on
the Kuomintang Principles which, to use Chen Niang-jien's own
words "he felt obliged to accept". The arrangement entered into
between the two parties were that no charges were to be made,
that the 3rd District Kuomintang Headquarters would supply the
speaker whose name was to be forwarded to the Broadcasting Station
every Saturday, that the subject to be broadcast was to be left
to the discretion of the speaker and announced when he took his
stand before the microphone.

The speaker on Sunday August 2 was one Loh of the 3rd
District Kuomintang who discoursed on Kuomintang matters and the
speaker on August 23 will be, it is reported, Col. Chen Hsi Tseng

主题（全称） 关于在租界内广播的反日运动演讲。

由 C. D. I. Robertson 制作并转呈

经查询，1931年8月17日《新闻报》及其他本地中文报纸上刊登的一篇文章（附译文）所述内容基本属实。该文章提及，大上海市政府社会局局长、新当选的国民党当地总部执行委员会委员潘公展（Pan Kung Chai），于8月16日上午10时至11时，通过“南京路大华电力供应公司广播电台”（即更为熟知的国家电气公司大中华广播电台）发表了一篇关于反日运动的演讲。据南京路501/3号国家电气公司经理陈仰乾（Chen Niang-jien）称，该公司拥有并经营位于同一地址的大中华广播电台。1931年7月，该台收到设在河南北路天后宫的国民党当地第三区党部的申请，请求自8月2日起，每周日上午10时至11时广播关于国民党原则的讲座。用陈仰乾自己的话说，他“觉得有义务接受”。双方达成的安排是：不收取任何费用；由国民党第三区党部提供演讲者，其姓名须于每周六提交给广播电台；广播主题由演讲者自行决定，并在其站在麦克风前时宣布。

8月2日（星期日）的演讲者是国民党第三区党部的一位罗姓（Loh）人士，论述了国民党相关事务。据报，8月23日的演讲者将是陈希曾（Chen Hsi Tseng）上校

Extract from the Chinese Afternoon Translation dated 17/8/31
----------------------------------------------------------------

Anti-Japanese Boycott Movement

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers publish
the following report :-

At the request of the local 3rd District Kuomintang
Branch, Mr. Pan Kung-chan, Chief of the Social Bureau of
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, at 10 a.m. yesterday
broadcasted his speech on the subject of "Nationalism
and Anti-Japanese Movement" using the radio station of the
Dah Chung Hwa Electricity Supply Company, Nanking Road.

In his speech, Mr. Pan urged the public to stick fast
to their present anti-Japanese boycott movement and not
follow the failures of last occasions. Mr. Pan concluded
that merchants should be persuaded, but not forced, to
refrain from dealing in Japanese goods and that definite
boycott schemes should be devised which, in a period
of five or ten years, would automatically oust Japanese
goods from Chinese markets altogether.

摘自1931年8月17日的中文午后译稿
----------------------------------------------------------------

抵制日货运动

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：

应国民党当地第三区党部之请，大上海市政府社会局局长潘公展先生于昨日上午10时，利用南京路大华电力供应公司的广播电台，发表了题为“民族主义与反日运动”的演讲。

在演讲中，潘先生敦促公众坚持当前的抵制日货运动，不要重蹈以往的覆辙。潘先生总结道，应劝说而非强迫商人停止经营日货，并应制定明确的抵制方案，以便在五至十年内将日货完全逐出中国市场。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, AUGUST 18, 1931

BOYCOTT PRESSURE
URGED BY RADIO

Chief Of Social Bureau
Broadcasts From
Local Station

A radio speech urging support
for the anti-Japanese boycott was
made from the Dah Chung Hwa
radio station on Sunday night, ac-
cording to the "Sin Wan Pao"
yesterday.
Dr. K. C. Pau, Chief of the Social
Bureau of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai made the speech
at the request of the local 3rd
District Kuomintang. He urged
the public to stick fast to their
present plans and not to mind past
failures. Merchants should be
persuaded, not forced, to refrain
from dealing in Japanese goods,
the speaker declared. Definite
boycott schemes should be formed
by means of which Japanese goods
would be ousted from the Chinese
markets within a period of from
five to ten years.

通过无线电
呼吁施加抵制压力

社会局局长
从本地电台
进行广播

据昨日《新闻报》报道，周日晚间，大华广播电台播出了一次呼吁支持抵制日货的无线电演讲。
大上海市政府社会局局长潘公展博士（Dr. K. C. Pau）应国民党当地第三区党部之请发表了此次演讲。他敦促公众坚持现有计划，不要在意过去的失败。演讲者宣称，应劝说而非强迫商人停止经营日货。应制定明确的抵制方案，借此在五至十年内将日货逐出中国市场。
